unsupported: The privately held company has grown to a staff of 50 to 99 employees, serving as a precision manufacturing partner for original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers.
The shop focuses on CNC machining and Swiss-type screw machining, producing small, intricate components from bar stock and billet.
In addition to machining, the facility runs PCB fabrication and assembly lines, turning out bare boards, populated assemblies, and membrane-switch panels.
The combined capability lets customers consolidate machined housings, interconnects, and electronics under one roof.
Programs range from ruggedized connector bodies and sensor housings for defense platforms to implantable-device components and diagnostic-instrument sub-assemblies for medical OEMs.

The company positions its differentiation on the integration of precision machining with full-spectrum PCB services, enabling shorter lead times and single-source accountability for complex electromechanical assemblies.

Known for: Combined CNC and Swiss screw machining with PCB fabrication and assembly; Specialization in small, intricate parts for high-reliability applications; Single-source electromechanical assembly for electronics, defense, and medical
